items.name: qr-code
items.title: QR Code
items.description: Styled, accessible QR code with download buttons: colors, gradients, patterns, logos and frame templates.
items.author: bucharitesh <https://qrdx.dev>
items.docs: Import it with `import { QrCode } from "@/components/qr-code"`. Props and examples: https://qrdx.dev/docs/components/qr-code

items.name: qr-code-card
items.title: QR Code Card
items.description: A card with a QR code in a "Scan me" frame, a title, a description and room for actions.
items.author: bucharitesh <https://qrdx.dev>
items.docs: Import it with `import { QrCodeCard } from "@/components/qr-code-card"`. Props and examples: https://qrdx.dev/docs/components/qr-code-card

items.name: qr-code-download
items.title: QR Code Download
items.description: A download menu that exports a QR code as PNG, SVG, JPG or PDF at the size you pick, or copies it as an image.
items.author: bucharitesh <https://qrdx.dev>
items.docs: Import it with `import { QrCodeDownload } from "@/components/qr-code-download"`. Props and examples: https://qrdx.dev/docs/components/qr-code-download

items.name: qr-code-share-dialog
items.title: QR Code Share Dialog
items.description: A share dialog with a QR code for a link, a copy button, a PNG download and the native share sheet.
items.author: bucharitesh <https://qrdx.dev>
items.docs: Import it with `import { QrCodeShareDialog } from "@/components/qr-code-share-dialog"`. Props and examples: https://qrdx.dev/docs/components/qr-code-share-dialog

items.name: qr-code-generator
items.title: QR Code Generator
items.description: A text input with a live QR code preview, style presets and download buttons.
items.author: bucharitesh <https://qrdx.dev>
items.docs: Import it with `import { QrCodeGenerator } from "@/components/qr-code-generator"`. Props and examples: https://qrdx.dev/docs/components/qr-code-generator

items.name: qr-code-scanner
items.title: QR Code Scanner
items.description: Drop zone that decodes a QR code from an uploaded image in the browser, using the qrdx library.
items.author: bucharitesh <https://qrdx.dev>
items.docs: Import it with `import { QrCodeScanner } from "@/components/qr-code-scanner"`. Props and examples: https://qrdx.dev/docs/components/qr-code-scanner

items.name: wifi-qr-code
items.title: Wi-Fi QR Code
items.description: A QR code that joins a Wi-Fi network when scanned, with a typed, escaped payload builder.
items.author: bucharitesh <https://qrdx.dev>
items.docs: Import it with `import { WifiQrCode } from "@/components/wifi-qr-code"`. Props and examples: https://qrdx.dev/docs/components/wifi-qr-code

items.name: vcard-qr-code
items.title: vCard QR Code
items.description: A QR code that saves a contact card when scanned, with a typed vCard 3.0 builder.
items.author: bucharitesh <https://qrdx.dev>
items.docs: Import it with `import { VCardQrCode } from "@/components/vcard-qr-code"`. Props and examples: https://qrdx.dev/docs/components/vcard-qr-code
